WALK.selection_rule: minimum Proposed Method 3D position RMSE among selected WALK trials
WALK.alignment: each estimate translated to Ground Truth at its first common valid sample
WALK.presentation: three-panel position, velocity, and attitude time histories with fixed method colors; angles in deg; position and velocity limits use Ground Truth plus Proposed Method only; py and pz share zero-centred limits; px span is an integer multiple of the common Y/Z span
